description:
Seo Cheongjin, a genius potter in the 21st century, possesses the body of a girl named Lee Yeong-Hwa in the Joseon Dynasty 500 years ago. Huh?! The ImJin War* is happening soon?! In order to go back to the present, Lee Yeong-Hwa will need to use her knowledge of history and make connections in order to survive. But why are historical figures coming closer and closer the further Yeong-Hwa is deviating from history?! 

*Japanese Invasion (1592)
